text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Nice to meetcha, Grandma♡

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ! How on earth did I become a grandma!???

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Being affectionately addressed as 
"Grandma" by Fusaichi Pandora, Sweep Tosho 
was throwing a pouty fit.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
'Cause, Sweep-chan... you're 
Craft-senpai's master, right?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
My master is Craft-senpai, and since 
you're her master... doesn't that make you 
Grandma?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Don't just make things up! It's true that 
I look after Craft, but still...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Then me too, me too! Forget racing, teach 
me all about witchcraft♪ Pretty please☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Okay?! Yay☆ Woohoo, brand new apprentice 
is born♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
! Don't just go being born without 
permission!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho was ultimately overwhelmed. 
And so, the two of them headed out to a 
cat café—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, if you aspire to be a witch, you 
must master handling your familiars.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Now, go and tame the cats here.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yup, got it♪ Let's be friends, kitty-kitty 
fluff-fluff☆

text_block_list.name: Pandora & Cats
text_block_list.text: Zzz... zzz... zzz Meoww... meoww...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
! Don't just curl up and fall asleep with 
them!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: *Yawn*... S-Sorry 'bout that...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Just as I thought, becoming a witch is 
impossible for you, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No matter how you look at it, you lack 
talent. You clearly don't have the blood 
of a witch in you!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, you think so~? Instead of witch 
blood, would Mama's blood work?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then—lunchtime.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What is this? There are way too many side 
vegetables on this plate...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Right~? I hate veggies~. I don't wanna eat 
anything except what I like~.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, for times like these, I have a 
special spell so we don't have to eat 
them!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You chant this incantation! Just watch!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no! I don't wanna eat them, I 
won't eat theeeem!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I use that magic all the time too♪ 
Alright, watch me!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
No way, no way, no way! I mean, 'cause, 
like, I really don't wanna eat iiiit!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
—!! Pandora! Just when I thought you were 
a failing student, you're actually pretty 
good!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You might actually have some promise. 
Alright, let's do it together!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Roger that, Grandma!

text_block_list.name: Sweep & Pandora
text_block_list.text: No, no, no! No way, no way, no way!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And so, the two of them continued 
throwing tantrums in perfect harmony.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded and doted on by all kinds of 
upperclassmen like this, Fusaichi Pandora 
seemed to be having a wonderful time.
